# CBS News

> > CBS News delivers breaking news, investigative journalism, and comprehensive coverage across politics, world events, entertainment, health, crime, and space exploration.

CBS News is a major American news organization providing real-time breaking news updates and in-depth reporting on U.S. and international events. The site covers critical topics including geopolitical conflicts, political developments, and investigative stories with daily updates across multiple news categories.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Trump Administration
- Iran Nuclear Conflict
- Middle East Crisis
- U.S. Military Deployment
- Strait of Hormuz
- Oil Prices
- Israel
- NATO
- Pentagon
- Geopolitics
- Crime & Investigations
- Health & Vaccines
- Entertainment
- Space Exploration

## Breaking News & Live Coverage

- [CBS News Homepage](https://www.cbsnews.com): CBS News homepage with breaking news coverage and top stories
- [Live Updates: Iran-U.S. Military Tensions](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-us-israel-gas-and-oil-prices-trump-netanyahu-strait-of-hormuz): Live coverage of Iran conflict with U.S. military deployment and oil price impacts

## News Sections

- [U.S. News](https://www.cbsnews.com/us): U.S. news section with daily breaking news updates from CBS News
- [World News](https://www.cbsnews.com/world): World news section with daily breaking news updates from CBS News
- [Politics News](https://www.cbsnews.com/politics): Politics news section covering elections, policies, and Trump administration
- [Crime News](https://www.cbsnews.com/crime): Crime news section with daily updates on crime and corruption stories

## Investigative & Special Reports

- [Hospice Fraud Investigation](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/hospice-fraud-investigation-los-angeles-office-plaza): Investigation into hospice fraud clustering at Los Angeles office plaza

## Lifestyle & Culture

- [Entertainment News](https://www.cbsnews.com/entertainment): Entertainment news section with celebrity, movies, TV, and music coverage
- [HealthWatch](https://www.cbsnews.com/healthwatch): Health news section covering vaccine policy, healthcare, and health regulations

## Science & Innovation

- [Space News](https://www.cbsnews.com/space): Space news section covering space exploration and scientific discoveries
